paragraphs: Bar Shlamia the scribe. See the entry "Bar."[^1][^2]

notes.text: Both נג: locators give 53b under the colon convention, without independently checked editions. Machine הנינא differs from supplied חנינא; Chanina follows the supplied source. The four separate units remain separate attestations, without merging their fathers.

ספרא is rendered the scribe as a lexical reading; teacher/scholar remains possible without an adjudicated occupational identity. Rav is explicit for Chanina and Yeimar; no title is added to Bar Shlamia.
